[color=#ff7700][size=4]Check Stack Fix

[b][color=#ffffff][size=3][OVERVIEW][/size][/color][/b][size=3]
[color=#007000][color=#000000][color=#ffffff] ﻿This mod fixes that game did not consider object type when determining player could get the dropped object (chests, furnaces, etc...)

[b][INSTALLATION INSTRUCTION]
[/b][/color][/color][/color][/size][/size][/color][list=1]
[*][size=3]Make sure you have installed [b]StardewValley 1.3 beta and SMAPI 2.6+ beta.[/b][/size]
[*][size=3]Download this mod.[/size]
[*][size=3]Extract "CheckStackFix" folder inside of the zip file to "Mods" folder. (structure will be like: Mods/CheckStackFix/...)[/size]
[*][size=3]Run the game and you should get effect of this mod.[/size]
[/list]

﻿[/b]You can see codes from [url=https://github.com/pomepome/StackCheckFix]GitHub[/url].
